verses.en: Unto thee, O God, do we give thanks, unto thee do we give thanks: for that thy name is near thy wondrous works declare.
verses.sm: Atua e, matou te vivii ia te oe; matou te vivii lava; aua ua latalata mai lou suafa; ua ta‘uatua ou vavega.

verses.en: When I shall receive the congregation I will judge uprightly.
verses.sm: ‚Pe a ou oo i ona po na tuu ai, ona a‘u faamasino tonu lea e a'u. Ua liu suavai le lalolagi

verses.en: The earth and all the inhabitants thereof are dissolved: I bear up the pillars of it. Selah.
verses.sm: atoa ma i latou uma ua nonofo ai; o aʻu nei ou te faatumauina ona pou tu. Sela.

verses.en: I said unto the fools, Deal not foolishly: and to the wicked, Lift not up the horn:
verses.sm: Na ou faapea atu i e ua valelea, Aua tou te amio faavalea; na ou fai atu foi i e amio leaga, Aua tou te faamaualugaina lo outou nifo;

verses.en: Lift not up your horn on high: speak not with a stiff neck.
verses.sm: aua tou te matua faamaualuga lo outou nifo;

verses.en: For promotion cometh neither from the east, nor from the west, nor from the south.
verses.sm: aua tou te tautalatala ma le úa maaa. Aua e le o sasae, po o sisifo, po o le vao e i ai mauga,

verses.en: But God is the judge: he putteth down one, and setteth up another.
verses.sm: a o le Atua na te faamasinoina; o ia na te faamaulaloina le tasi,

verses.en: For in the hand of the LORD there is a cup, and the wine is red; it is full of mixture; and he poureth out of the same: but the dregs thereof, all the wicked of the earth shall wring them out, and drink them.
verses.sm: o ia foi na te faaeaina i luga le tasi. Auā o loo i le aao o le Aw le ipu, ua mumu foi le uaina; ua tumu i le uaina filogia; e liligiina atu foi e ia ai lenei lava ipu; a o ona “alu, e taulia e faainu aʻi o e amio leaga uma i le lalolagi.

verses.en: But I will declare for ever; I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.
verses.sm: Aoaf'u,ou te taʻu atu e faavavau;

verses.en: All the horns of the wicked also will I cut off; but the horns of the righteous shall be exalted.
verses.sm: 10 11 12 ou te fai pesega lava i le Atua o lakopo. O nifo uma foi o e amio leaga, ou te vavaeeseina ia; a e faamaualugaina nifo o lé amiotonu.
